title: An amazing piece of history made so clear to us by our wonderful guide!
text: Our guide was wonderful. He was full of so much information and we understood him perfectly. His name is Antonio Villalobos. He certainly made our trip a great success!!
author: Colleen C

title: Wow, what an amazing experience.  Absolutely stunning…and Fernando the guide was superb for the whole 2.5 hour tour!
text:
A superb tour by our guide, Fernando, of what can only be described as the stunningly beautiful and outstanding gardens and palaces of Alhambra. 

Our guide Fernando was excellent; polite, fluent in English and shared with us the history of “his office” also know as Alhambra.   

Perfect day out.!
author: Jon_Holder

title: Great, fantastic experience thanks to the Alain guide
text: Great experience, our guide Alain made the tour even more interesting proving professional friendly and exhaustive. I recommend this tour to everyone

title: Beautiful! Informative! Eye opening!
text: What a wonderfully informative and beautiful tour. So worth having a guide (Alain) to take us through time and space to understand Alhambra.
author: Leslie L

title: Wonderful tour of the Alhambra!
text: The Alhambra is a World Heritage Site by UNESCO and is one of the most visited sites in the world. We bought tickets 3 months in advance to tour the Alhambra, Nasrid Palace, Alcazaba, Palace of Charles V and Generalife Place/Gardens. Granavision’s guide Antonio Villalobos was extremely knowledgeable about the site, history and the culture, over 3.5 hrs he patiently explained the history of the site!
author: Journey234355

title: Alhambra with Carlos Serrano
text: Our German speaking guide Carlos Serrano guided us in a small group perfectly and also very personally through the Alhambra with the beautiful gardens.
